adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the Lark refresh request is now wrapped in `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. When `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && credential.userId` is true, `refreshOAuthTokens` bypasses the Lark `fetch(`${this.url}/authen/v1/refresh_access_token`, ...)` call and instead `fetch`es `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` with a different payload/expected response (per comment: “response should only contain the access token and expiry date”). The returned `resp` is still passed to `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, this.log)`, which is intended for Lark API responses and will be incompatible if the sync endpoint does not return the Lark `{code,msg,data}` envelope. This is a concrete behavior change introduced by the diff and would break token refresh for Lark when the sync feature is enabled.
